title: Positive velocity composition and the Fizeau comparison
description:
The unique positive velocity-composition law, derived from four bilinear forms and reconstructed exactly from retained forward and held products. Maria Smith presents the complete Smithian Fold Theory argument for C(u,v)=(u+v)/(1+uv), strict closure, limiting absorption, associative finite composition and the original Fizeau moving-medium comparison.

Includes full rational mathematics, native Lean proof constructions, the optical phase-shift derivation, measured water slope, both relativistic predictions, ordinary-addition alternative, air control and every registered systematic condition. The complete relativistic bracket contains the measured interval; its nearest prediction is 11.56 times closer to the measured centre than ordinary addition.

Two source entries, 2,304 complete candidate decisions and 334 distinct empty-axiom audited declarations. Original pinned V3 and V4 source citations, reproducible exact comparisons and primary-source evidence accompany the paper.
